## Checklist

- [ ] Tests named for the scenario back each delivery, ordering, security or compatibility claim.
- [ ] DESIGN.md is updated if behaviour changed. DECISIONS.md has an entry if a dependency, protocol message, MCP tool, CLI command, config key or table was added.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has a line under Unreleased if a user or agent would notice.
- [ ] `make check` and `make lint` pass.
- [ ] The diff was reviewed by a different model family or a person.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`). If an agent wrote this, its user takes responsibility for it.
